test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Washing soda is:
solution:
The correct answer is __a basic salt.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• We know that **sodium hydrogen carbonate **is a **basic salt **because it is made when a **strong base**, such as **NaOH**, and a weak acid, such as** H2CO3,** **neutralise **one another.
 
• **Strong heating **of **sodium hydrogen carbonate **results in the production of **sodium carbonate**, **water**, and **carbon dioxide**.
 
• It involves the **subsequent reactions**:
 
 
• NaHCO₃ ₊ heat → Na₂CO₃+H₂O+CO₂
 
 
 
• By **crystallising **NaHCO3, Na₂CO3.10H₂O is produced **(washing soda).**
 
• Washing soda is** sodium carbonate, **which is formed upon **crystallisation **as **Na₂CO3.10H2O.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Washing soda is a **salt **of **carbonic acid**, a substance that also yields a variety of other salts referred to as **carbonates**.
 
• In order to help **other cleaning agents **remove **filth **from **garments **and suspend it in the wash water, **sodium carbonate softens water**.
 
• The washing soda **bonds **to the **minerals**, making the water harder and enabling the detergent to adequately **penetrate **the **fibres **to clean the clothing.
